about: Corporate actions on candidate ETFs, each with the documents that support it. announced_on is the date the action became public, taken from the document's own text; a point-in-time decision may use an action only on or after that date, and an action without it can never explain an earlier price break. A verified action's units multiplier and dates are stated in an official document; they are never derived from a price change, which is only checked against them. Unverified actions are leads: they resolve nothing. On the BSE files checked, PREVCLOSE was not restated on split ex-dates, so price files alone cannot confirm a split.
